sourceNote: A copy of the T-pose mesh assets/models/hippo/hippo-tpose.glb (armSource) with new quad tubes on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist, at the length of the mesh. tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py makes these faces, with the wrist cut at 0.2 of the paw (--spec, assets/models/hippo/README.md). The other faces and hippo-tpose.glb stay unchanged.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the weight rules of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, because the seated bind of the app depends on them.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone. The helper is twice the gap of the elbow rings of tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py (step_skeleton() prints it).
armSegments.rootSegmentNote: The rule weight of each upper arm goes to its first segment (segment_joints() and main() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that the trunk around the socket takes the roll of the first ring of the tube. Without it, three to four faces of the right shoulder fold in the reach of the bow arm (arm gate folds p95 4).

armSmooth.note: 6 rounds of taubin() smooth the arm tubes after the weights (arm_smooth() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that the tubes lose the ridges of the big faces of the T-pose mesh, as on the rhino.

name: Hippo

app.note: The scale puts the standing skull top (the highest vertex within 0.03 u of the middle plane, 0.9839 u) at 1.570 m, the head height of the red fox: 1.595711 m for each unit, with the standing shoulder joints at 1.008489 m (ANIMALS). The reach is the reach of the arms of the mesh, from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.

armFactorNote: The arms keep the length of the mesh (arm_rebuild.py with no --factor). The new grip of the contrabass (HIPPO_HOLD of src/pose/bowed-rig.ts) reaches each note target, so the arms need no stretch. The contrabass of the hippo is smaller (bassScale 0.8 of src/models/species.ts).
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. The hippo stands at its contrabass in the app, as the hippos of the reference images, so no seat asks for longer legs.

rootNormals.note: The skin faces whose middle lies within radius (units) of the head of an upper arm take the skin normals with no crease angle in the app (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), so that a raised arm root shows no dark crease.
rootNormals.armShareNote: A face of the radius stays in the rim only when the mean weight of its corners on the clavicle and the arm bones of its side is 0.3 or more (root_rim()). Thus the big trunk faces under the left armpit keep their own normals and show no dark patch.
rootNormals.turnNote: A face of the rim keeps the crease normals when a corner takes a skin normal more than 60 degrees from its own face in the final bind (rim_turns()). Thus the big trunk face under the right armpit shows no black wedge under the bow arm.
rootNormals.elbowNote: The faces within 0.09 units of each elbow joint take the skin normals (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The left paw on the neck bends the left elbow far, and split normals would show a thin dark line across the elbow.

jointsNote: The places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tops, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The arms are in a T-pose, and the claws make a row under the end of each paw, so the palm faces down. The shoulder joint lies 0.035 u inside the line where the arm leaves the trunk, and the elbow lies halfway from the shoulder joint to the wrist. The neck joint lies below the chin.

studio.bindArmsNote: With straightArms, bindArms.upper_arm sets the bind upper arm, and bindArms.forearm sets only the elbow axis: the cross product of the bind upper arm and this forearm direction (StudioBody.hinges, bind_hinges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The two directions are the directions of the old bent bind, so that the elbow axes and the zero of the roll of the upper arm stay. The paw has no bind direction, because it keeps the turn of the upper arm.
studio.straightArmsNote: The bind keeps the arms of the source straight: the forearm and the paw keep the turn of the upper arm, so that the rest shape holds the bend of no role, and each hold bends the elbow and the wrist from the same shape (the role-neutral bind of design 4.4).
studio.bindSupinationNote: The bind paw of each arm turns about its bind forearm toward supination, the left 20 degrees and the right 0 degrees (paw_supination() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py), and the forearm segments share the turn. The rule of design 4.4 gives L 111 and R 38 (two probes of pnpm bind-supination hippo), but the own role wins: each 20 degrees more on the left takes the left forearm deeper into the neck of the contrabass at rest (0 gives 1.1 cm, 40 gives 1.6 cm, 111 gives 1.7 cm), and R 38 turns the right paw 177 degrees in a move (limit 176). With 20, the left paw twist p95 of the bassist is 161 degrees (limit 170).
studio.note: legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind to the source (tools/rig/leg_turns.py <config> 25 15 0). The hippo stands in the app, so no player sits in this pose.

sliver.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, and the panda.

line.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, and the panda.

weights.clavicleMiddleNote: The share of the clavicle weight that a vertex below headFrom keeps grows from 0 at the smaller distance from the middle plane to 1 at the larger distance (units), and the chest takes the rest. Thus the bow arm does not fold the chest under the chin.
weights.armTopNote: The share of the clavicle and upper arm weights that a vertex gives to the neck grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height (units): from the middle of the T-pose arm root to its top under the chin.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the round haunch stays on the hips. It starts below the crotch and ends at the thigh joint.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones (armFree). Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. The tail is a ball on one bone (tailBall).

armFree.note: The T-pose arm is free of the trunk beyond x 0.2 (the cuts of assets/models/hippo/README.md). A vertex of the free arm lies beyond |x| = armSplit, within 0.11 u of the chain of the arm joints, and above y 0.53, so that the round belly under the arm follows the trunk.

flip.note: The rule of the fox, the rabbit, the cat, the dog, and the panda, with a lower angle, a larger move, and wider normals (refine.flipNote).

refine.ringsNote: The rig has no rings. The rebuilt tubes have rings at each elbow and each wrist.
refine.flipNote: The long edge of each thin face of the arms in the seated bind flips (flip_edges() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The angle 130, the move 0.004, and the normals 90 flip more of them.

check.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, and the panda.

tone.note: The texture has a pinker fur than SPECIES_COLORS.hippo. Each plain face takes the hue and the chroma of the species color of its band (the accent, the fur, and the belly) and keeps its lightness: a row is [L, dL, da, db] in Oklab, from the mean Oklab color of the faces of the mesh in each band. The claws keep their colors.

colors.note: The values of samples, palette, dark, and eyeShare are the values of the other meshes. A dark face in the eye box is an eye face. The config has no nose box, because the hippo has no nose pad: the export takes the front of the muzzle as the nose tip.

eyeShell.note: The values of the fox, the cat, and the dog. The old eye of each side is its dark faces and the faces around them, and they take the color of the faces around them.

chair.note: The chair of the rig sets the seat top of the seated bind under the haunch. The short thighs lie under the belly, so the seat ends behind them. The hippo stands in the app (soloist of ANIMALS), so no player sits on this seat.

crease.note: The values of the cat, the dog, and the panda.

sit.note: The values of the panda: the haunch moves down at most 0.03 u.

armSourceNote: The T-pose mesh of the hippo (assets/models/hippo/README.md). Its arms are level and free of the trunk, so tools/blender/arm_rebuild.py rebuilds them with no species script.
